scope: One brief original race activation visual and synthetic finite audio variants. No app/button/sensor code, no recorded V8 file.

registration.layer: WORLD-space backdrop below existing Buddy; not face-local. SVGs contain no eyes/mouth. Preview canonical face is static reference ONLY.
registration.motion: Flags fixed, opacity fade only. Confetti may drift down<=5 canonical units and horizontally<=1 over1.25s; no strobe/flashing. Remove by1.25s, no particle system needed.
registration.reduced_motion: Static flags+confetti with opacity fade only.
registration.trigger: Once on explicit Race-mode activation, not every tilt/update. Never lock car input while art plays. Turning Race off, mute audio, hidden/pagehide or exit cleans sources/timers/art.

cue_policy: race_activate_rev plays once at activation0; then nothing loops. Acceleration/braking: choose one of two short variants per distinct CONDITION ENTRY (not every frame).>=1.5s global sound cooldown; require neutral>=.30s before rearming same event. No immediate repeat; do not stack activation rev with reaction sound. Current mute and cleanup apply. Do not reuse full seven-second scripted racer track for live car reactions.

acceleration: Small push-back stretch: scaleX.94 scaleY1.06 translateY+5 in face100 units, ease .15s.
Smaller excited lean: scaleX.97 scaleY1.04 rotate+2deg translateY+3, ease .15s.
braking: Soft forward squash: scaleX1.10 scaleY.88 translateY-3, ease .12s then neutral .35s.
Small recoil: scaleX1.07 scaleY.92 translateY-2 then scaleX.98 scaleY1.03 rebound over .40s.
motion_variants.instruction: Creative small targets, Code adapts current bounds/calibration. Rotate variations on event entry; preserve face paths/colours and banking. Reduced motion static expression or minimal scale, no bob.

v8_limitation: ALL supplied sounds are original SYNTHETIC placeholders, NOT a V8 recording or acoustically verified V8 model. Scout is researching a real recording separately; do not describe these as the requested recorded V8. External asset still requires Mike review before download under current project rule. Originals need no additional approval wait.
provenance: Original handwritten checker flags/confetti geometry and original mathematical engine/brake synthesis; no brand, recording, sample, copied theme, external image or download.
ui_handoff: Mike requests a more DISCREET Teleport button (latest direction overrides earlier prominence) and a distinct Race toggle. Code owns UI implementation, preserve discoverability/accessibility.
